TICKET
# Cart.php class method _deleteCustomization not deleting all image files from same customization but only first

I have a product with multiple customization fields: 11 text fields, and 3 file fields.
Saving customization fields to product works well.
But when I remove a product from Cart, customization data is deleted from Database correctly, but attached image files stored at /upload/ folder are not fully deleted. It deletes only first image file, and other image files like 2nd and 3rd remains there

Place where bug is i think: Cart.php class method _deleteCustomization

## Attendu
When I delete a Product from Cart with multiple customization fields, I expect all physically image files from customization fields type 'FILE' are deleted from /upload/ folder and not only first.

## Étapes
1. in admin create a Product with more customization fields e.g. 5 text fields, and 3 file fields
2. in frontend fill all customization fields (into file fields upload 3 JPG images)
3. add this product to Cart, and for now all is fine
4. now in Cart remove this product from Cart
5. check the folder /upload/ and you will see that 1st image file was deleted, and 2nd and 3rd image file were not deleted
